claim_boundary: This artifact is an acquisition handoff only. It contains no real measured campus × meal-period × service rows, proves no raw operational data access, and is not benchmark, pilot-evidence, savings, or operational-readiness evidence until real measured records, source semantics, and access are verified.

actual_served.availability_semantics: Post-service reconciled aggregate only. A BUCard passage/meal transaction must not be assumed to equal one accepted served meal until Dining Services confirms duplicate, reversal, second-meal, staff/student, package-sale versus package-pickup, and correction rules. report_generated_at and source_report_id must be retained.

produced_portions.availability_semantics: Must represent actual produced portions for the same campus × meal period × service date and may become available only after production is recorded.

surplus_or_waste.availability_semantics: Must be an accepted measured surplus/waste outcome tied to the same service; TrayGate percentage outputs are not mass or gram truth without separate measured calibration.

shortage_or_early_sellout.availability_semantics: Must be a post-service reconciled outcome or timestamped incident record; absence of a record cannot be silently interpreted as no shortage.

operator_status_quo_quantity.availability_semantics: Must be the quantity estimate or plan actually available before the registered decision_cutoff_at, preserved with an immutable timestamp/snapshot.

menu.availability_semantics: Only a menu snapshot demonstrably published or available no later than decision_cutoff_at may enter historical decision inputs. Archive existence alone does not prove historical publication time.

academic_calendar.availability_semantics: Use only the calendar/version known by decision_cutoff_at; later corrections must not leak backward into historical features.

weather_forecast.availability_semantics: Use only an immutable forecast snapshot demonstrably issued and available no later than decision_cutoff_at; later observations, reanalysis, or revised forecasts must not leak backward into historical decision inputs.
